<h2>Load Named Configuration Value</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Loads one nested value from a named project configuration.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>load_config_value(config_id, value, file = here::here("config.yml"))
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="config_id">config_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Single non-empty configuration identifier declared in the YAML file.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="value">value</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character vector specifying the nested configuration key path.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="file">file</code></td>
<td>
<p>Path to the generated YAML configuration file.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Use [load_config()] when the complete named configuration is needed. This
function is the canonical project boundary around [config::get()] for values
from an explicitly named configuration.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>The value associated with the requested key path.
</p>


<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[load_config()], [load_active_config_value()]
</p>

</main>
